baseline_models.focus_anchor: The resultative construction joins جَعَلَ to غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ as a caused state.
baseline_models.mechanism: A referent is made to cross into the state of pasture reduced to dry refuse, with dark coloration registering the completed material change.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state makes the verb the causal hinge of the transformation.
Pasture dried into chaff-like refuse supplies both the prior vegetal state and its spoiled result.
Blackish or dark-greenish coloring makes darkness the visible finish of the reduction.

changed_reading.after: He caused it to pass from growth into dry, spoiled refuse whose darkened color exposes the completed change.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: غُثَاءً can be flood-borne surface refuse, while the root of أَحْوَىٰ also carries gathering, holding, and water-catchment images.
baseline_models.mechanism: The product is not merely scattered dry matter: it can be imagined as mobile debris gathered by water and arrested in a dark mass or holding place.

activation_trace.role: Caused state-change links the original referent to a newly aggregated material condition.
Floating refuse carried by floodwater supplies mobility, surface position, and heterogeneous accumulation.
Gathering and holding turns the color word's root into an exploratory image of debris collected into one mass.
Enclosed catchments that retain floodwater provide a possible spatial endpoint for the floating debris.

changed_reading.before: The referent simply dries into dark chaff.
changed_reading.after: The referent becomes flood-mobile refuse that gathers, darkens, and lodges as a contained surface mass.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The result noun غُثَاءً includes refuse that is not counted or valued.
baseline_models.mechanism: The caused change is simultaneously material and classificatory: what had a prior identity is reassigned to the category of negligible remainder.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state supports a change of status as well as substance.
Unregarded refuse supplies the endpoint of devaluation: material present but no longer taken into account.
Dark coloration gives the loss of standing a concrete visible surface.

changed_reading.after: The line enacts a collapse of standing: the transformed material remains visible but is recategorized as something not worth counting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening field of swimming motion, elevation, and the upper direction meets refuse that literally floats. This separates spatial topness from true rank: the least valued matter may occupy the uppermost visible layer.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or rapid movement activates the literal surface motion latent in flood-borne refuse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, completion, measure, directed course, emergence, and pasture form an ordered production chain. The focus is its terminal operation, so decay reads as a governed phase of the same making rather than an accidental failure outside it.

Grazing growth and pasture identify the focus pronoun's vegetal input.
Caused state-change performs the chain's final conversion.
Pasture reduced to dry refuse closes the exact material trajectory opened in the prior verse.
Darkening registers the terminal condition on the material itself.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a measured, directed sequence from emergence of pasture to caused refuse. I infer that the final reduction belongs to the same governance as the earlier formation. A live alternative is that the ordered verbs frame power while the decay itself remains only a contrastive warning.

changed_reading.before: The pasture flourishes and then happens to decay.
changed_reading.after: The pasture's emergence, allotted course, and dark reduction are successive governed states within one complete lifecycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering into recitation, the negation of forgetting, renewed remembrance, and benefit activate a retention contrast. The focus becomes the negative material image of what ordinary processes cast off, while protected and useful form is gathered and recalled.

activation_trace.role: Unregarded material supplies the discarded side of the retention contrast.
Gathering and holding supplies an exploratory counter-image of retained material.
Collection and gathering make recitation a process of assembling rather than merely sounding units.
The forgotten thing as something cast away supplies the loss that the verse explicitly negates.
Bringing something back after forgetting supplies active retrieval of what remains available.
Benefit supplies the criterion that distinguishes retained signal from valueless residue.

structural_cues: The focus is immediately followed by a promise of recitation and non-forgetting.
The later repetition of remembrance pairs retention with benefit rather than mere persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, explicitly negated forgetting, retrieval, and benefit beside unregarded and held material. I infer a material-to-cognitive sieve analogy. A live alternative is that the focus closes the creation scene and does not model memory at all.

changed_reading.before: The focus only describes vegetal waste.
changed_reading.after: The vegetal waste also acts as a negative foil for memory: residue is what a process sheds, whereas useful form is gathered, protected, and made recallable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit visible-hidden opposition turns floating dark residue into evidence. What appears at the surface is no longer only an endpoint; it is a legible output of a transformation whose earlier workings are concealed.

activation_trace.role: Floating refuse supplies a visible surface layer produced by processes not themselves shown.
Containment supplies an inward or held domain behind the exposed layer.
A distinguishing mark that guides to what was there lets residue function as material evidence.
Manifest appearance to the eye defines the exposed side of the mechanism.
Concealment defines the unseen history that the visible residue indirectly discloses.

structural_cues: 87:7 places the manifest and the hidden in an explicit antithesis.
The focus itself juxtaposes a surface-capable noun with a dark adjective and a root carrying containment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible surface product, containment, a guiding mark, and the manifest-hidden pair. I infer that the product can reveal its hidden process as evidence. A live alternative is that 87:7 concerns exhaustive knowledge without recoding the earlier material image.

changed_reading.before: Dark refuse is only the dead endpoint of growth.
changed_reading.after: The dark floating layer is a diagnostic trace: a visible residue through which an otherwise hidden history of change becomes knowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Benefit, separation, cutting open, and purification revise decay into sorting. The focus can image the fraction excluded as negligible residue, not the indiscriminate erasure of everything that grew.

activation_trace.role: Unregarded refuse supplies the rejected fraction after discrimination.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies a positive criterion for sorting.
Putting aside and distancing gives the mechanism a separating motion.
Splitting and cutting supplies a material operation that opens one mass into distinct fractions.
Purity and soundness identify the retained counterpart to refuse.

structural_cues: 87:9-15 repeatedly divides response, consequence, and outcome into contrasting paths.
The agricultural focus image makes the later roots of cutting and purification available as material operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies benefit, distancing, splitting, purification, and valueless residue. I infer a common sorting mechanism in which the focus names the rejected fraction. A live alternative is that the later contrasts are ethical only and do not imply selective processing of the pasture image.

changed_reading.before: All growth ends alike as refuse.
changed_reading.after: The focus can depict a discriminating process: what lacks use is separated as refuse, while the contrastive sequence keeps open a purified or beneficial remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later contact with blazing fire supplies a possible causal route for the focus color. Dry vegetal refuse is reread as heat-blackened or carbonized matter, not only as vegetation darkened by drying.

activation_trace.role: Dried pasture supplies combustible vegetal material.
Blackish coloring supplies the visible result that heat could explain.
Kindling heat and altering or straightening a thing by fire supplies the transformative operation.
Blazing fire confirms heat as a salient later material image.

structural_cues: The focus's dark color is followed later by an explicit greater fire.
Both scenes describe a state imposed on material, allowing a backward causal analogy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dry pasture, blackish color, and later fire that transforms what meets it. I infer heat-blackening as one possible material bridge. A live alternative is ordinary darkening through desiccation, moisture, or age, with no fire acting on the pasture.

changed_reading.before: The chaff is dark because its growth has withered.
changed_reading.after: The chaff can carry a thermal afterimage: dry growth rendered black residue by a transforming heat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later refusal of both death and life activates an intermediate material status already present in the focus. The pasture is no longer living growth, yet it has not vanished; it persists as mobile or collected remainder.

activation_trace.role: Former pasture persisting as dry refuse supplies matter after the loss of vegetal vitality.
Floating and transport show that the deadened product remains materially active rather than absent.
Stillness and quiescence supply a death-like state short of simple disappearance.
Land revived through rain and vegetation recalls the living state from which the residue has fallen.

structural_cues: 87:13 explicitly suspends its subject between dying and living.
The focus product is grammatically a new state of the pasture, not its deletion from the scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies former vegetation that persists as refuse and a later neither-dead-nor-living construction. I infer a shared liminal-state pattern. A live alternative is that the later suspension names a distinct punitive condition and does not reactivate the pasture.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts the clean extinction of living growth.
changed_reading.after: The focus depicts an after-state: no longer living pasture, not absent matter, but residue that persists, gathers, and moves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference for the near and the claim that the later is better and more enduring force a distinction between mere leftover material and valuable continuance. The focus residue may persist physically, but its persistence is exactly what does not make it worth choosing.

activation_trace.role: Unregarded refuse supplies survival without recognized worth.
Gathering and retaining show that material can remain held even after losing value.
Choosing one thing over another supplies the evaluative act that mere persistence cannot settle.
A remaining old fatty trace or extracted remnant activates a second, materially specific kind of leftover.
Nearness places immediate availability on one side of the choice.
Deferral to a later time places delayed outcome against the near surface.
Inclination toward useful good makes benefit, not mere duration, the value test.
Continuance supplies durable remaining as the explicit positive comparison.
The remainder sense makes the lexical collision with focus refuse direct while preserving their difference in value.

structural_cues: 87:16-17 sets near preference against a later state explicitly described by both goodness and endurance.
The focus has already shown that a remainder can stay materially present while becoming unregarded.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies choice, nearness, delay, useful good, enduring remainder, and unregarded residue. I infer that the text distinguishes valued endurance from bare leftover persistence. A live alternative is that غثاء vanishes quickly, so its role is only the opposite of every kind of remaining.

changed_reading.before: The focus proves that whatever exists now simply disappears.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes two after-states: matter may remain as worthless residue, while what is better remains with value; persistence alone is not the criterion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A split-root rain mark, a distinguishing sign, a surviving trace, and a broad written surface converge on the focus. Vegetation first marks the land, then its dark residue remains on the surface as a material record of the cycle that produced it.

activation_trace.role: The first rain marking the earth with vegetation supplies an initial inscription in living material.
A floating layer of gathered plant residue supplies the later physical trace left on a surface.
Dark coloration makes the residual trace visually legible.
A distinguishing mark that guides to its cause lets the dark layer signify prior growth.
A remaining sign of what once was turns residue into historical evidence.
Breadth and spread supply the land or water surface on which the trace can be read.
The written sheet supplies the record analogy that converts a residual layer into material script.

structural_cues: The sequence begins with a name whose split mapping includes rain marking earth and ends by invoking written sheets.
Between those poles, visible-hidden knowledge and a lasting trace make reading from marks a recurrent possibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-marked earth, dark surface residue, a guiding sign, a surviving trace, and broad written sheets. I infer that the residue can be read as the land's material record. A live alternative is that these marking branches remain separate lexical echoes and never form an inscription mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The residue is worthless because it is merely what remains after growth.
changed_reading.after: Without recovering practical worth, the dark residue can still be evidentiary: a surface inscription recording the passage from rain-marked growth to exhaustion.

changed_reading.after: The same refuse can be felt from inside as a nauseating, gut-coiling encounter with corruption.

Dark green-black coloring makes the surface layer visually compatible with an algal bloom.
Algae rising on water turns preference into an exploratory image of choosing what blooms visibly at the surface.
Nearness makes the surface bloom immediately available and therefore tempting.

changed_reading.after: It can also figure a near, visible surface bloom that attracts preference precisely while concealing its refuse-like substance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a branch reached through أُولَىٰ pictures liquid thickening at its final outcome, apparently reversing the source word's ordinary firstness. It remains anchored through the focus's water-borne refuse and catchment branches, but downstream prose should call it a form-distant material activation, not replace the primary dried-pasture reading with coagulation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventories allow refuse on liquid and a structure holding water; the later split inventory supplies liquid congealing at the end of its process.

activation_trace.role: Scum and low material gathered on liquid supply a surface phase capable of thickening.
A water-holding enclosure supplies the bounded liquid environment in which matter accumulates.
Liquid thickening or congealing at its final outcome supplies an alternative physical pathway to a dense residual layer.

changed_reading.before: The pasture becomes loose dry chaff.
changed_reading.after: Alongside drying, the focus can momentarily be seen as matter concentrating and congealing at a liquid surface into a dark terminal layer.

strongest_changes: The creation sequence makes dark reduction a governed lifecycle phase rather than an accidental collapse.
The later visible-hidden pair turns surface refuse into evidence of a concealed material history.
The near-versus-enduring comparison distinguishes worthless leftover persistence from valuable continuance.
Retention, remembrance, and benefit let the focus operate as a negative image of what a filtering process casts away.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive surprise came from treating residue as active rather than empty: it floats, gathers, marks, records, and can persist without value. Split mappings intensified this through rain marking earth, algae rising on water, and liquid congealing at an endpoint, while the primary color-and-chaff reading remained intact.
remaining_uncertainties: أَحْوَىٰ most directly supports dark coloration; gathering, inwardness, and catchment readings remain root-level exploratory activations.
The fire-blackening model depends on a backward material analogy because the packet does not state that the later fire acts on the pasture.
The memory, inscription, and sorting models are mechanistically coherent but cross domains and should coexist with, not displace, the ecological reading.
The split-root algae and congealing activations are worth preserving as outliers, but their distance from the source forms keeps confidence exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The green yield becomes flood refuse.** Lexical evidence: ج ع ل B002 (turning into a state), غ ث و B001/B002 (flood refuse and dried pasture chaff), ح و ي B006 (dark blackish coloring). Structural cue: direct pronoun returns to المرعى in 87:4; fa- marks transformation. Assigned role: جعل executes state-change; غثاء names the reduced material; أحوى gives the darkened end-state. Abductive move: the pasture's final visible form reveals the instability of worldly growth. Reading change: the ayah becomes the ecological argument later stated ethically in 87:16-17.

2. **Discarded memory versus preserved recitation.** Lexical evidence: غ ث و B004 (unregarded refuse), ن س ي B003 in 87:6 (forgotten cast-off thing), ق ر ء B001/B002 (gathered recitation), ب ق ي B001/B002 in 87:17. Structural cue: the verse about chaff is followed immediately by "We will make you recite, so you will not forget." Assigned role: غثاء provides the negative image of what happens when form is not preserved. Abductive move: forgetting is a cognitive analogue to biomass becoming refuse. Reading change: 87:5 prepares the anti-forgetting promise.

3. **Containment turned dark.** Lexical evidence: ح و ي B001/B002/B006 (gathering/holding, coiling, dark coloring), ق ر ء B001 (gathering speech), ص ح ف B003 (collected sheets). Structural cue: the root ح و ي can imply containment, while later recitation/sheets gather meaning. Assigned role: أحوى is a dark gathered mass, contrasting with orderly gathering. Abductive move: not every gathering preserves value; some gathering is waste accumulation. Reading change: the ayah distinguishes decomposing collection from scriptural/recitative collection.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:6 made غثاء feel like the physical image of نسيان: what is not held in ordered recitation becomes cast-off matter. 87:17's أبقى then made the chaff an explicit foil for what remains.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Green provision turned into flood-refuse.** Lexical evidence: جعل B002 turning something into a state; غثو B001 floating refuse carried by floodwater and B002 pasture dried into chaff-like refuse; حوي B006 dark reddish/blackish coloring. Structural cue: the pronoun returns to المرعى of 87:4 and the فـ makes transformation immediate. Assigned role: جعل performs state-change; غثاء names the degraded residue; أحوى marks darkening. Abductive move: the packet supplies pasture and refuse; I infer decay after growth. Reading change: the ayah reads as the lifecycle of worldly provision, not a separate punishment scene.

2. **Containment and gathering in decay.** Lexical evidence: حوي B001 gathering/holding, B002 coiling/rounding, B008 enclosed water catchments; غثو B001 refuse gathered on water. Structural cue: refuse is not only dry; it is gathered and carried. Assigned role: أحوى may activate enclosure/aggregation around the waste. Abductive move: the packet supplies water-surface refuse and holding basins; I infer that decay collects what once grew. Reading change: the image becomes a hydrological sorting: life emerges, then remnants are gathered into dark scum.

3. **Low-value people/things as moral metaphor.** Lexical evidence: غثو B004 unregarded refuse; شقو B002 hardship in 87:11; دنو B003 baseness in 87:16. Structural cue: the later avoidant "الأشقى" and preference for الدنيا follow the vegetation/refuse cycle. Assigned role: the pasture's fate becomes a moral analogy for choosing the low and perishing. Abductive move: the packet gives metaphorical refuse and later moral failure; I infer analogy from sequence. Reading change: the ayah becomes a warning about human valuation, not only natural decay.

4. **A darkened opposite to purification.** Lexical evidence: حوي B006 dark coloring; سبح B002 declaring free/purifying; زكو B002 purity/rectitude in 87:14. Structural cue: darkened refuse stands before later purification and prayer. Assigned role: أحوى provides the visual negative of تزكى. Abductive move: the packet supplies darkening and purity; I infer contrast as a moral-visual mechanism. Reading change: the ayah sets up purification as refusal to become dark residue.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:14 made the refuse image morally sharper: تزكى is not only piety but a counter-process to becoming غثاء. 87:18-19 also reframed this transience as an old recorded lesson, not merely local observation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The verse describes controlled phase conversion.** `ج ع ل/B002` is turning something into a state, `غ ث و/B002` is pasture dried or reduced into chaff-like refuse, and `ح و ي/B006` supplies the dark or blackish coloring of `أَحْوَىٰ`. The pronoun reverses the emergence of pasture in 87:4, and `فـ` binds input to result. Each branch has a distinct role: transformation, material endpoint, and visible condition. I infer an ordered lifecycle rather than accidental spoilage. The ayah reads as deliberate state change, not a static picture of debris.
2. **Decay redistributes and gathers rather than simply erases.** `غ ث و/B001` gives refuse floating or carried by floodwater, while latent `ح و ي/B001` gives gathering and holding; the surface adjective still retains its direct color support in `ح و ي/B006`. The branch image of low material collected one layer over another supplies the structural bridge between the two roots. I infer transport and accumulation from the accepted refuse image, since no water is stated in the ayah. The result becomes a dark gathered residue whose form has changed but whose matter remains.
3. **Material discard becomes a model for informational sorting.** `غ ث و/B004` is what is unregarded and allowed to go to waste. In 87:6, `ن س ي/B003` supplies the forgotten cast-off thing, while 87:9–10 activates `ذ ك ر/B009` and `ذ ك ر/B003` as reminder and recovered presence. The fixed refuse therefore plays the rejected-output role against protected recitation and recollection. I infer a material-to-cognitive analogy; the packet does not equate vegetation with discourse. The ayah gains a contrast between what an ordered process discards and what the next sequence preserves.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later recitation/reminder sequence in 87:6 and 87:9–10 produced the largest surprise. `غ ث و/B004` and the cast-off branch `ن س ي/B003` turned vegetal refuse into a material analogy for selective retention: the ordered system discards one output while preserving and reactivating another.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, selin taşıdığı veya suyun ve tencerenin yüzüne çıkardığı kuru bitki, köpük, kumaş parçası ve benzeri değersiz döküntüleri aynı maddi çekirdekte toplar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve suyun yaprak, kamış ya da hayvan pisliğiyle dolması gibi bağlı kullanımları doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağımsız olarak adlandırılan yüzey döküntüsünü temel alır; vadi ve suyla kurulan ifadeler ise bu maddenin gelmesini veya suda çoğalmasını anlatan yapıya bağlı kullanımlar olarak ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Selin taşıdığı veya su yüzünde yüzen kuru bitki, kumaş parçası ve benzeri değersiz maddelerden oluşan döküntüdür.
Tencerenin ya da başka bir sıvının yüzüne çıkan köpük ve kuru bitki parçaları da bu adlandırmanın kapsamına girer.
Suyun hayvan pisliği, yaprak, kamış ve benzeri döküntülerle dolması, aynı maddi görüntüyü kuran yapıya bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, selin getirdiği veya sıvı yüzeyine çıkan kuru bitki ve çeşitli değersiz parçaların oluşturduğu döküntüdür. Toplu anlatım, sel suyunu, su yüzeyini ve tencere yüzeyini kapsar; suyun yaprak, kamış ve hayvan pisliğiyle dolmasını da aynı görüntüye bağlı olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı gerçekleşmeyi açıkça bir araya getirir: selin otlağı yığıp tadını gidermesi ve yeşil bitkinin kurutularak kuru, ufalanmış ota çevrilmesi. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu işlem, önceki durum ve ortaya çıkan sonuç ayrımlarını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kuru bitki maddesinin genel adı değil, otlağın selce yığılması ve niteliğini yitirmesi ya da bitkinin yeşillikten kuru ufalanmış hale getirilmesi sürecidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, sel ile otlak arasındaki yapıya bağlı yığma ve tadı giderme kullanımını, bitkiyi kuru ufalanmış hale getiren ettirgen kullanımdan ayırır; bunlardan bağımsız genel bir kuruma anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Selin otlağı bir araya yığıp tadını gidermesi veya bitkinin yeşil halinden kuru, ufalanmış ota dönüştürülmesidir. İlk kullanım selin otlak üzerindeki işlemini, ikincisi ise kurutma sonucunu öne çıkarır.

facets.statement: Otlak sel tarafından yığılıp tadını yitirir ya da bitki yeşillikten sonra kuru ve ufalanmış hale getirilir.
Sel, otlağı parça parça bir araya yığar ve onun tadını ya da otlak değerini giderir.
Dönüşümün sonucu, yeşillikten sonra kurumuş ve ufalanmış bitki olarak da açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, selin otlağı yığarak tadını gidermesini ve bitkinin yeşil durumdan kuru, ufalanmış hale çevrilmesini aynı sonuç çizgisinde buluşturur. Böylece yalnız kuruluk değil, önceki canlılık ve yararlılığın bir işlem sonucunda yitirilmesi de korunur.

concept_gloss.text: bitkiyi kuru ve ufalanmış hale getirmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Bitkinin yeşil ve yararlı durumdan çıkarılıp kuru, parçalanmış ve niteliğini yitirmiş hale dönüştürülmesini anlatan ortak sonuç için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıçtaki canlı durum ile işlem sonunda ortaya çıkan kuru ve ufalanmış durum arasındaki dönüşümü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Selin otlak parçalarını bir araya topladığı ve otlağın yenilebilir niteliğini ortadan kaldırdığı yapıya bağlı bağlam içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Selin yapan taraf oluşunu, yığma işlemini ve otlağın tadını yitirmesi sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitkinin önceki yeşil halinden kurutulup ufalanmış ot haline getirildiğinin özellikle belirtildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yeşillikten kuruluğa geçişi, ettirgen dönüşümü ve ortaya çıkan kuru bitki sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin içinin bozulup rahatsız edici bir şeyle kabarması biçimindeki bulantı durumunu ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Bulantı çekirdeği kabul edilmekle birlikte ikinci fiil biçimi kaynaklar arasında tartışmalıdır: ayn bunu aktarır, tahdhib ise al-Layth rivayetini sonraki dönem kullanımına bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sel döküntüsünü, kuru otu veya değersiz insan benzetmesini değil, kişinin içinde duyduğu bulantı ve rahatsız edici kabarma durumunu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bulantı adı ile kişinin içinin bulanmasını bildiren yapıya bağlı fiil kullanımları ayrı tutulur; tanım bunları kusma eylemine ya da genel hastalığa genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin içinde rahatsız edici bir şey yükseliyormuş gibi oluşan bulanma ve kabarma durumudur. Bu durum bir duyum olarak kalabilir ve kusmanın gerçekleşmesini zorunlu kılmaz.

facets.statement: Kişinin içi bozulur ve rahatsız edici bir şeyle kabarıp dalgalanıyormuş gibi bir bulantı duyulur.
Aynı durum, iç bulanması adıyla veya kişinin içinin bulanmasını bildiren farklı fiil biçimleriyle anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin içinde rahatsız edici bir kabarma ve bozulma olarak duyulan bulantıda birleşir. Toplu ifade durumun adını ve kişinin içinin bulanmasını bildiren biçimleri kapsar, fakat kusmayı kurucu sonuç yapmaz; ikinci fiil biçiminin geçerliliği kaynaklar arasında tartışmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sel döküntüsünün değersiz ve kolayca sürüklenip gitme görüntüsünden hareketle toplumun aşağı görülen kesimine ve önemsenmeden boşa giden şeye yapılan benzetmeyi açıkça kurar. Dal çerçevesi, maddi kökeni yalnız benzetmenin dayanağı olarak tutup mecazi değersizlik çekirdeğini doğru verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçek sel döküntüsünü veya bulantıyı değil, değersiz görülüp önemsenmeyen insanları ve boşa gidip kaybolan şeyleri benzetme yoluyla anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağımsız biçimin mecazi değersizlik anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki su, otlak veya bulantı yapıları bu yalın dalın anlamına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Selin sürüklediği değersiz döküntüye benzetilerek, toplumun aşağı ve önemsiz görülen kesimi ya da değer verilmeyip boşa giden şey için kullanılan adlandırmadır.

facets.statement: İnsan topluluğu aşağı ve değersiz görülmesi bakımından, şey ise önemsenmeden boşa gidip kaybolması bakımından sel döküntüsüne benzetilir.
Toplumun aşağı, önemsiz ve değer verilmeyen kesimi bu küçültücü benzetmeyle adlandırılır.
Önemsenmeden boşa giden ve kalıcı bir değer bırakmadan kaybolan şeyler için de aynı benzetme kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, değersiz sel döküntüsünü bir benzetme dayanağına dönüştürür. Bu benzetme bir yandan toplumun aşağı görülen kesimini, öte yandan önemsenmeden boşa gidip kaybolan şeyi anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحوي الحويض الصغير للبعير، والحوايا حفائر ملتوية في القيعان والرياض تمسك ماء السيل، والمساطح التي يحوى لها التراب والحجارة لحبس الماء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الحوايا الأمعاء إلا من جهة التشبيه المصرح به، ولا الحوية مركب المرأة أو كساء البعير.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحوي الحويض الصغير يسويه الرجل لبعيره يسقيه فيه (tahdhib)؛ الحوايا التي تكون في القيعان والرياض حفائر ملتوية يملؤها ماء السيل (tahdhib)؛ الحوايا المساطح وهو أن يعمدوا إلى الصفا فيحوون له ترابا وحجارة ليحبس عليهم الماء (tahdhib)

source_note.TA: Tek kaynak küçük deve yalağını, sel suyuyla dolan kıvrımlı çukurları ve toprak-taş çevrili toplama yüzeylerini birlikte kaydeder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü doğrudan hasta veya rahatsız kimse anlamında açıklar ve aynı cümledeki başka bir sözcüğün akılsız anlamını ayrı tutar. Geçici çerçeve bu yalın kişi niteliğini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hastalık durumundaki kişiyi niteler; akılsızlık, genel zayıflık veya belirli bir hastalık türü anlamın parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tek başına kullanılan hasta kişi niteliğiyle sınırlıdır; belirli hastalık, ateş veya güçsüzlük türleri eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bedensel bir rahatsızlığı veya hastalığı bulunan kişi için kullanılan yalın bir nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Gönderim, bedensel olarak hasta veya rahatsız durumda bulunan kişidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtın çekirdeği herhangi bir hastalık türünü belirtmeden kişiyi hasta veya rahatsız olarak nitelemektir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak bu biçimi hasta kişi anlamında verir ve yanındaki akılsızlık bildiren ayrı sözcükten açıkça ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hastalığın türü belirtilmeden bir kişinin bedensel rahatsızlık durumunun anlatıldığı kullanımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hasta kişiye yönelik yalın nitelemeyi ve bedensel rahatsızlık sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin hastalığının türü veya ağırlığı belirtilmeden yapılan genel nitelemede doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi genel olarak hasta sayan çekirdek anlamı bütünüyle korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca hasta kişiyi adlandıran yalın ve tek kaynaklı bir nitelemedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hastalık durumunun adı, sürekli hasta olma ve bir hastalığın kişiyi hasta etmesi komşuda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bedensel hastalık içindeki kişiyi niteleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kişi nitelemesinde yakın karşılık vardır; komşu dal ayrıca hastalık durumunu ve hastalandırma eylemini kapsadığı için sınırı daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın kanıtı doğrudan hasta kişiye yönelik tek bir nitelemedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hastalık, sakatlık, eksilme, hasta görünme ve maldaki bozulma komşunun geniş kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin sağlıklı durumdan çıkıp hasta olması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnızca hasta kişiyi gösterir; komşu dal hastalık durumunu, davranışı ve beden dışındaki eksilmeleri de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hastalığın kendisi odak dalda yeterlidir; ayrıca güç kaybı şart değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Açlık veya hastalık yüzünden gücün azalması komşu dalın zorunlu sonucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Hastalık bir kişide güçsüzlük doğurduğunda iki dal aynı durumda buluşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hasta kişiyi niteler; komşu dal hastalık ya da açlığın yol açtığı güç azalmasını anlatır ve hastalık olmadan da gerçekleşebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün hastalık ve kök içi adaylar değerlendirildi; genel bedensel hastalık, geniş sağlık kaybı ve hastalığa bağlı güçsüzlük sınırları yayımlandı, özel ateş ve organ kusuru adayları elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قول ابن الأعرابي الحوي العليل، على أنه لفظ مفرد مشدد ذكره تهذيب اللغة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الدوي الأحمق، ولا حوى بمعنى جمع، ولا الحوة اللون.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحوي العليل والدوي الأحمق مشددات كلها (tahdhib)

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.
